what: Mistake: corrected job 20261024-220848-engm's reading to time on a synthetic fixture while the request itself still asked for timing on this repository; the critic rightly judged the reading a misread of the request and planning stopped, costing a run ($0.88) and a re-ask.
why: A correction that contradicts the request's own words should be a new request (or an edit of the request), not a correction of the reading; athena correct could warn when a correction overrides an explicit requirement of the request.
